title: HTF Rayleigh Certificate v1
description: A replayable certificate that E0 <= interval.upper, produced by the Rayleigh-Ritz theorem.

claim.description: Human-readable statement of what is certified.

assumptions.description: Machine-checked preconditions; each entry must have passed before the certificate was issued.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical (H || psi) bytes (row-major float64).

interval.description: Arb interval for the Rayleigh quotient; the certified claim is E0 <= upper.

radius.description: Half-width (rounding radius); 0 when backend is numpy-float.

backend.description: Arithmetic backend. 'flint-arb' means a rigorous Arb ball was computed; 'numpy-float' means no certified rounding.

htf_version.description: Version of HTF that produced this certificate.

verified.description: True if verify_rayleigh_certificate() confirmed this certificate independently.
